output.summary: This market lets you predict if the Federal Reserve will not change interest rates after their October 2026 meeting. A YES share costs about 83 cents, which shows that the market thinks there's an 83% chance rates will stay the same. In these markets, a YES share pays $1 if the event happens, or nothing if it doesn't. So the price in cents roughly equals the chance the event will happen.
